patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — HubSpot documents a broader use-case set; Adobe Marketo Engage is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose HubSpot only if your buying job matches “AI-powered customer platform with free forever CRM, plus paid Smart CRM seats and Sales/Ma” rather than Adobe Marketo Engage's shape. Choose Adobe Marketo Engage only if your buying job matches “Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM se” rather than HubSpot's shape. Workflow advantage: HubSpot leans pipeline-management, lead-management; Adobe Marketo Engage leans marketing-automation, lead-generation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — HubSpot documents a broader use-case set; Adobe Marketo Engage is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: HubSpot is AI-powered customer platform with free forever CRM, plus paid Smart CRM seats and Sales/Marketing/Service hubs for growing teams.; Adobe Marketo Engage is Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM secondary..
- Company-size focus: HubSpot (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Adobe Marketo Engage (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: HubSpot-leaning pipeline-management, lead-management, sales-automation vs Adobe Marketo Engage-leaning marketing-automation, lead-generation, lead-nurturing.
- Researched limits: HubSpot — Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.; Adobe Marketo Engage — Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency.

Limitations — HubSpot: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.; Sales Hub Professional starts at $100/month per seat on the Product & Services Catalog and the Sales product page (re-checked 2026-08-18). HubSpot’s Sales pricing page also shows $90/mo/seat billed annually vs $100 monthly, plus required Professional onboarding ($1,500). Starter marketing prices show new-customer discounts (*).; Adobe Marketo Engage: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Implementation/ops overhead is enterprise-grade.

Poor-fit cases: HubSpot is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats. · Adobe Marketo Engage is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency · Avoid HubSpot if you actually need Adobe Marketo Engage's motion (Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quo)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
